subject.title: fix(openai): show account models after API-key onboarding

question: Should the protected OpenAI provider change be approved after the branch is rebased and its account-aware catalog metadata is rechecked against current `main`?
rationale: The patch changes the API-key provider’s user-selectable model catalog and carries a protected `maintainer` label; a human should confirm the supported-model and billing/capability metadata before merge.

options.title: Rebase and approve
options.body: Refresh the branch against current `main`, confirm the discovered-model metadata and fallback tests still pass, then merge the provider-local repair.

options.title: Narrow the catalog
options.body: Limit the supplemental projection to the models maintainers explicitly want to support if any listed model’s modality, context, or pricing contract is not accepted.

recommendation.title: Rebase and approve
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current `main`, confirm the discovered-model metadata and fallback tests still pass, then merge the provider-local repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this contributor directly to the OpenAI provider repair and its live onboarding proof, though broader current-main ownership could not be established from the read-only inspection available.
